tagDefinitions.Uncensored: The maintained upstream catalog explicitly marks the model uncensored.
tagDefinitions.Coding: The upstream catalog identifies the model as code-optimized or its official model name is code-specific.
tagDefinitions.Reasoning: The upstream catalog explicitly identifies reasoning support.
tagDefinitions.Vision: The upstream catalog explicitly identifies image input support.
tagDefinitions.Web search: The upstream catalog identifies a search-specialized model with integrated web search.
tagDefinitions.Audio input: The upstream catalog explicitly identifies audio input support.
tagDefinitions.Video input: The upstream catalog explicitly identifies video input support.
tagDefinitions.Roleplay: The official model name identifies a roleplay specialization.
tagDefinitions.Anime: The official model name identifies an anime image specialization.
tagDefinitions.Fast: The official model name or maintained upstream trait identifies a speed-optimized variant.
tagDefinitions.Open weights: A maintained upstream description explicitly identifies the model as open-source or open-weight.
